status: experimental interpretation of painted labels; not observed biome ground truth
objective: Equal weight per painted zone; half mean categorical match, half mean exp(-distance_squared/2) to the allowed polygons. Distance is zero inside an allowed envelope; axes scaled by 5 C and 500 mm/year. No seasonal or terrain factors enter this experimental objective.
limitations: Cold winters do not uniquely imply low mean annual temperature or boreal vegetation.
Woodland/shrubland does not establish Mediterranean summer drought.
Tropical rainforest does not establish swamp hydrology; seasonal forests can also contain wetlands.
The tropical seasonal forest/savanna envelope combines forest and grass-dominated vegetation.
The broad profile has overlapping target sets, so it separates the painted categories less strongly.
Changing this file changes the calibration hypothesis; preserve its hash with each run.
